These queries are untested, since I could not run anything. They are written from the documentation page alone.

R1: filter ~(/active) | filter ~(at :address | ne null) | filter ~(/address | at :city | coalesce "" | lower | eq "berlin") | * /name | sort
R2: filter ~(at :age | ne null) | * /age | avg | round 2
R3: filter ~(/status | eq "paid") | groupBy ~/customer * (* (/items * (mulOf /qty /price) | sum) | sum | round 2)
R4: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | * (at :assignee | coalesce {:login "unassigned"} | /login) | groupBy * count
R5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 | * /number
R6: [(/dependencies | filter ~(startsWith "^") | keys) (/devDependencies | filter ~(startsWith "^") | keys)] | unionOf /0 /1 | sort | * keyword
R7: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) | * (split " ") | filter ~(/3 | parseJson | gte 500) | * /2 | distinct | sort
R8: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) | * (split " ") | filter ~(/1 | eq "GET") | * (/4 | split "ms" | /0 | parseJson) | avg | round 0
R9: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(count | gt 0) | * (split ",") | filter ~(/2 | ne "") | groupBy ~/1 * (* (/2 | parseJson) | avg | round 1)
R10: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(count | gt 0) | * (split "," | /3 | split ";") | flat | filter ~(ne "") | * lower | distinct | sort
R11: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) | filter ~(startsWith "DB_") | * (split "=" | [(/0 | trim | drop 3 | lower | keyword) (drop 1 | join "=" | trim)]) | tag ::map
R12: /services | entries | filter ~(/1 | at :enabled | eq true) | * {:name (/0 | keyword) :url (/1 | [/protocol "://" /host ":" (at :port | coalesce 80 | print)] | join "")} | sort ~/name
R13: :p (filter ~(/type | eq "purchase")) | {:total (p * (/meta | at :amount | coalesce 0) | sum | round 2) :users (p * /user | distinct | count) :hasRefund (any ~(/type | lower | eq "refund"))}
R14: ["Apple" "banana" "apple" "Cherry" "BANANA" "date" "Elder" "cherry" "fig" "Apple"] | * lower | groupBy * count | filter ~(gt 1) | keys | sort | * keyword
